content.title: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments

content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Bitcoin payment

Understanding Bitcoin payments for digital downloads is essential for creators looking to retain more of their revenue. Traditional platforms like Gumroad impose a 10% fee on sales, while NOWPayments only charges 0.5%. This fee difference means that for 100 sales of a $97 product, you would retain an additional $921. Such savings can significantly impact your bottom line, especially for independent creators building their brands in restrictive financial environments.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The architecture behind Bitcoin payments for digital downloads relies on several key components that work seamlessly together. You'll host your digital products on platforms like GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages, which provide free hosting solutions. Payment processing is managed by NOWPayments, enabling you to accept over 300 cryptocurrencies with minimal transaction fees. This setup eliminates reliance on traditional banking systems, ensuring that you maintain full control and ownership of your digital store.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This infrastructure is built for digital creators—authors, educators, designers, and developers—in regions where major payment processors are inaccessible. If you're selling ebooks, online courses, software, or templates, you need a reliable payment system that respects your autonomy. This framework empowers you to sell directly to your audience without the barriers imposed by conventional platforms, allowing for greater flexibility and improved profit margins.
Retain more revenue with lower fees—NOWPayments charges only 0.5%.
The Components That Make It Work Together

Key components of this infrastructure include GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for hosting, combined with NOWPayments for accepting Bitcoin. Using Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers, you can automate the delivery of your digital products upon payment confirmation. This integration ensures a smooth user experience while allowing you to scale your operations without being tied to subscription fees or platform limitations.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To deploy this infrastructure, start by setting up your hosting on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. Next, integrate NOWPayments for processing Bitcoin transactions. Then, use Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers to automate product delivery. Finally, ensure that your digital products are ready and test the entire process to confirm that payments trigger automatic fulfillment. With the Complete Builder Kit ($197), you can access all the blueprints and templates needed to streamline this setup.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

You can sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe by using a sovereign digital commerce stack that facilitates Bitcoin payments. This setup allows you to host your products independently, accept cryptocurrency directly, and automate product delivery. By eliminating reliance on conventional payment platforms, you ensure greater control and lower transaction costs.
Automate product delivery for a seamless customer experience.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

If you're looking to sell ebooks or digital products without the fees from platforms like Gumroad, consider the Complete Builder Kit ($197). This package includes everything you need to build, deploy, and scale your sovereign digital commerce stack. Explore more at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Prepare your product files in delivery-ready format — PDF for ebooks, ZIP archives for multi-file products, exported files for Notion templates, OTF and TTF archives for font families. Set your prices in USD and let NOWPayments handle the crypto equivalent calculation automatically at transaction time. Deploy your stack and configure the product list with file paths, USD prices, and delivery settings. Configure your storefront with product pages and checkout flow. Test the checkout on both desktop and mobile — confirm QR codes generate correctly and live price feeds display accurately. Complete a real mainnet test transaction and confirm the delivery email arrives with a working download link. Check your order database and confirm the test transaction appears with all correct fields.
Frequently Asked Questions
How do I set up NOWPayments for my digital store?

To set up NOWPayments, sign up on their platform and follow the integration guide provided. You'll need to connect it to your hosting solution, ensuring that your products are linked to the payment gateway for seamless transactions.
What should I use for hosting my digital products?
You can use GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for hosting your digital products. Both platforms offer free hosting options that are reliable and easy to set up, allowing you to focus on your content.
How can I automate product delivery?

Automate product delivery using Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers. These tools enable you to set up triggers that automatically send your digital products to customers once their payment is confirmed.
Are there any transaction fees with Bitcoin payments?
Yes, while NOWPayments charges a low fee of 0.5% for transactions, it's significantly lower than conventional platforms like Gumroad, which charges 10%. This means more revenue stays in your pocket.
Can I sell multiple types of digital products?
Absolutely, this infrastructure supports various digital products, including ebooks, courses, templates, and software. You have the flexibility to tailor your offerings to your audience's needs.
